name: 30° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, 30° dive, 400 kt, release by 4,000 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 30° / 400 KIAS / 4,000 ft — check the mod's depression tables for the actual load

procedure: Bombing mode MANUAL, station selected, sight depression set
Roll in, establish 30° and 400 kt — hold them
Pipper on the target at release altitude: pickle, 4 G recovery

name: 45° Manual Dive
summary: Fixed sight, steep dive from 10,000 ft, release by 5,500 ft

sight.notes: Mk-82 LD, 45° / 420 KIAS / 5,500 ft — check the depression tables

procedure: Bombing mode MANUAL, sight depression set
Steep roll-in; speed brakes as needed to hold 420 kt
Pipper on at release altitude: pickle, 4.5 G recovery — do not press

name: CP-741 30° (computed)
summary: Designate in the dive, hold the pickle, the CP-741 releases
procedure: Bombing mode CP-741 (computer), radar altimeter on
Roll in, pipper on the target, pickle and HOLD
Keep flying the pipper on — the computer releases; pull when it does

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
procedure: Level at 500 ft, 420 kt — pickle as the target passes the reticle

name: Gun 10°
summary: Shallow gun pass, cease by 1,000 ft
procedure: Guns selected, sight depression for guns
Roll in, pipper on, short bursts
Cease fire at 1,000 ft and pull — never press a gun pass
